payload.summary: Compared six Earshot branches and rehearsed merges in an isolated managed worktree. Two branches merged only DIP activity paths and no product code; canonical and library showed DIP conflicts, transport eight product conflicts, synthesis two product conflicts. Existing integration was previously verified with 42 web and 17 Rust tests. Did not add historical DIP records or mutate main.
